selection: Practical bounded five following accepted ten; refactor and correctness repairs are prerequisites and excluded from the five. All new implementations require fresh final acceptance.
research_execution_scope: Read existing source, policy, matrix, reports and archived handoffs. No compiler or oracle execution during this audit. Historical first-diagnostic app reports do not establish current blockers.
selection_tradeoff: Prioritizes substantial archived work and manageable new semantics plus repair dependencies. Inner classes and value ABI have stronger direct AndroidBible impact but much larger constructor/capture/representation changes. Class delegation has no observed AndroidBible use in the archived official PSI inventory.
